notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one creature that can deal unblocked combat damage to an opponent.
You control lands capable of tapping for at least {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
description:
Attack with your creature.
On combat damage, Nature's Will triggers, tapping all lands the player you damaged controls and untapping your lands.
Activate Najeela for {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, untapping your attacking creatures, giving them trample, lifelink, and haste, and adding an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat.
